team_key.description: Default Linear team key (e.g., 'LIN'). Used when no team is specified in commands.

repo_name.description: Name used for repo: label in Linear. Overrides auto-detection from git remote or directory name.

use_issue_types.description: Enable issue type labels (Bug, Feature, Task, etc.) using Linear label groups. When false, types are not tracked.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: How long to trust cached data before re-syncing from Linear, in seconds.

local_only.description: Run in local-only mode without syncing to Linear. Issues get LOCAL-xxx IDs. Useful for LLM-only task tracking.

repo_scope.description: How to scope issues to this repo in Linear. 'label' uses repo:name labels. 'project' uses Linear Projects. 'both' uses both for filtering/assignment. When omitted, repo_binding_version controls the implicit fallback.

repo_binding_version.description: Binding policy version for implicit repo scope fallback when repo_scope is not explicitly set. Version 1 defaults to label scope, version 2 defaults to project scope.

min_cli_version.description: Minimum lb CLI version required for this repository (for example: 'v16'). Older binaries exit early with an upgrade message.

issue_backend.description: Issue backend adapter. 'linear' uses Linear GraphQL. 'local' keeps issue operations local-only.

mail_backend.description: Mail backend adapter. 'local' keeps mail in local SQLite. 'linear' projects mail through Linear comments.
